classification: Public-field Singer membership: paid known Shor arithmetic plus Theta(sqrt(q)) query access, not a new mechanism or complete classical dequantization.
source_interface: Only secret input: XOR membership Tr_(E/F_q)(alpha^(k+s))=0 on canonical Z_v. Field representation, base embedding and primitive alpha public. No beta/program or extra unknown oracle.
mechanism: Known coherent log_alpha(x), membership kickback, cleanup, Grover recurrence and additive Fourier annihilator readout; public trace-pairing inverse and known residual DLog.
exact_output_law: j charged phase queries: zero output cos^2(2j theta), each of q-1 nonzero normal coordinates sin^2(2j theta)/(q-1), theta=asin(1/sqrt(q)). All other outputs zero under exact promise.
query_accounting: Choose j uniformly below ceil(q/sqrt(q-1)); mean correct normal >=1/4. R repetitions fail <=(3/4)^R. At most R(J-1) secret membership calls, 2R(J-1) clean known-log maps, 4R(J-1) underlying boosted DLog computation/inverse calls; at most one additional residual solver.
matching_lower_scope: Prior uniform-shift sparse-membership gate gives Omega(sqrt(q)) for constant success; arbitrary known processing allowed. No general full-function DHSP transfer.
dependencies: supplied public field and primitive element
uniform coherent known quantum discrete logarithm
coherent cleanup with worst-case input error
additive QFT and public trace-pairing inverse

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review coordinate quotient periodicity, zero-branch XOR control, Grover/Fourier output law, random-schedule bound and matching lower scope.
proof_obligations.PO-COMPILER: Tables are calibration only. A real compiler must implement known DLog coherently, with workspace cleanup and total known-operation costs.
proof_obligations.PO-PRECISION: For Q phase calls budget e<=(delta/(4Q))^2 uniformly for coordinate DLog outputs. Residual output failure, QFT and physical compilation errors additional.
proof_obligations.PO-PRIME-POWER: Literal controls use prime q; arbitrary prime-power subfield embeddings and absolute-trace Fourier coordinates not implemented.
proof_obligations.PO-SETUP: Public primitive and field setup supplied; bounded factorization/table construction is not polynomial classical setup.
proof_obligations.PO-REDUCTION: No admission of generic HSP/lattice consequence without a natural reduction preserving this special public-field promise.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: No algorithm candidate unless a genuinely new residual/mechanism survives known Shor comparison and the sparse access gate.
